title: Update delivery-tracker tests for new AI Factory methods
spec:
The tracker.py was updated to add AI Factory standard methods. The existing test_tracker.py needs coverage for these additions.

Files to update:
- agents/delivery-tracker/tests/test_tracker.py

New methods added to DeliveryTracker (tracker.py):
1. `trust_tier: str = "T1"` — class attribute
2. `validate_inputs()` — raises ValueError if HELIX_BASE_URL or HELIX_API_TOKEN is empty (delegates to self.settings.validate_helix())
3. `handle_error(exc)` — logs and re-raises the exception
4. `run()` — now calls validate_inputs() at start, tracks records/errors counters, prints [METRICS] on every exit path

Tests to add:
- test_trust_tier: assert DeliveryTracker.trust_tier == "T1"
- test_validate_inputs_passes: mock settings.validate_helix() returning True, assert no exception raised
- test_validate_inputs_fails: mock settings.validate_helix() returning False, assert ValueError raised with correct message
- test_handle_error_reraises: pass an exception to handle_error(), assert it is re-raised
- test_run_prints_metrics (capsys): mock HelixClient, run a happy path, assert "[METRICS]" appears in captured stdout
- test_run_metrics_on_validation_failure (capsys): run with invalid settings, assert "[METRICS]" still appears in stdout

Fixtures already in conftest.py — use mock_settings and patch 'tracker.HelixClient'.

AI Factory standard: every run() exit path must print [METRICS].
